races.paceDynamic: Faeberon and Sweet Love are the only confirmed pace-setters, with Jambearee potentially joining them early before fading. With just 2-3 horses going forward, this creates a sustainable tempo that won't stress the leaders through the early stages. The majority of the field are hold-up horses who will be tracking behind, setting up a tactical affair where positioning becomes crucial. This pace dynamic strongly favours prominent runners who can sit close to the pace without having to make dramatic late moves.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable pace holds
scenarios.trigger: If Faeberon and Sweet Love set modest fractions without pressure
scenarios.body: The front duo maintain their advantage as the hold-up brigade struggle to close on the flat Thirsk track. Prominent runners get first run on the field while late closers find themselves outpaced by the sustainable tempo.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early pace collapse
scenarios.trigger: If both Faeberon and Sweet Love go too fast early or clash for the lead
scenarios.body: The pace-setters weaken dramatically in the final furlong, opening the door for the strongest finishers. Hold-up horses get the perfect setup as the race falls apart in front of them.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Jambearee disrupts rhythm
scenarios.trigger: If Jambearee races keenly and forces a faster pace before fading
scenarios.body: The early tempo becomes more demanding than expected, stretching the field and creating gaps. This suits horses with tactical speed who can bridge between the early pace and late runners.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete tactical stalemate
scenarios.trigger: If nobody wants to make the running and they crawl early
scenarios.body: An ultra-slow pace turns into a sprint finish where class tells and any horse can win. The race becomes a lottery where positioning in the final two furlongs matters more than running style.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Jambearee races too keenly early as this could force a faster pace than expected and disrupt the tactical nature
Monitor the gap between the front two and the field after four furlongs - if it stretches beyond three lengths the hold-up horses are in trouble

Watch for any interference or trouble in running as the large field of hold-up horses will be bunched together turning for home
Observe if either Faeberon or Sweet Love show signs of stopping in the final furlong as both have stamina questions at this trip

races.paceDynamic: Law Of Average stands alone as the confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the gates in this 18-runner sprint handicap. With no other genuine pace-setters, Law Of Average can bowl along at a comfortable rhythm without pressure, likely joined by prominent runners Right And Exact, Castan, and Emerald Harmony tracking just behind. The large field contains predominantly hold-up horses including Muker, Pixie Diva, Brazilian Belle, and Al Hussar who will be relying on a strong pace collapse. This uncontested lead scenario with minimal early pace strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to Law Of Average early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Law Of Average gets an easy lead with minimal pressure through halfway
scenarios.body: Law Of Average faces no serious pace pressure and kicks clear in the final furlong as the hold-up horses struggle to make up ground from the back of this large field. The prominent runners tracking behind also benefit from the lack of early pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounces
scenarios.trigger: If Law Of Average sets steady fractions but weakens in the final furlong
scenarios.body: The patient prominent runners who tracked the leader strike as Law Of Average begins to tire, with the race becoming a battle between those positioned handy throughout. Hold-up horses still struggle to make significant inroads from the rear.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes faster than expected or Law Of Average stops quickly
scenarios.body: The large field bunches up entering the final two furlongs allowing the hold-up horses to unleash their finishing kicks. Brazilian Belle, Pixie Diva and Al Hussar benefit from a true-run race where stamina tells.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Law Of Average goes very slowly early and the field remains tightly bunched
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with little separation until the final furlong sprint. Any horse with a turn of foot can win regardless of early positioning as the race breaks up late.

watchPoints.text: Law Of Average breaking slowly or being challenged for the early lead would completely change this race dynamic

Brazilian Belle and Pixie Diva need the pace to develop more than expected to have realistic chances
Glory Fighter's recent win came from prominent position and similar tactics needed here

races.paceDynamic: Pink Azalea is the sole confirmed front runner in this 12-runner field, meaning she can dictate terms without pressure through the early stages. With most of the field preferring to race prominently or hold up (Selection and Ey Up Its Jazz the only other prominent types), Pink Azalea will face minimal early competition for the lead. This sets up a controlled tempo that allows her to conserve energy before quickening, while the large pack of hold-up horses behind will need to find racing room and time their challenges perfectly. The race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the traffic problems that will inevitably develop in the congested pack behind.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Pink Azalea breaks cleanly and faces no early pressure for the lead
scenarios.body: She can dictate a steady tempo and have plenty left for the finish, while the crowded field behind struggles for racing room. Her sustainable pace advantage becomes decisive when the hold-up horses make their late moves too late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Pink Azalea misses the break or gets headed early by prominent runners
scenarios.body: Selection or Ey Up Its Jazz could steal a march by pressing forward, creating a faster tempo that sets up the race for strong finishers. The hold-up horses get the strong pace they need to unleash their finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Race Tactical Battle
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys try to improve position approaching the turn, creating a mid-race squeeze
scenarios.body: The prominent runners get caught in traffic while Pink Azalea maintains her position out front, but some hold-up horses find clear runs. Racing room becomes the decisive factor rather than pure ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If Pink Azalea goes too fast early under pressure from multiple prominent runners
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable, setting up a perfect scenario for the strongest finishers from the back. Class tells as the better-rated hold-up horses sweep past tired leaders.

races.paceDynamic: City Of Poets emerges as the sole confirmed front-runner with a natural prominent style, likely to dictate terms from the start without pressure from natural leaders. The majority of this field comprises hold-up horses (Oolong Poobong, Capital Guarantee, Frankies Dream, Impartiality, Leadenhall, Count Palatine, Mr Professor) who will be content to settle behind the early pace. With limited early pace pressure, City Of Poets can control fractions and potentially steal a march on the closers who may find themselves with too much ground to make up. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent runners and those able to track the early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If City Of Poets establishes an uncontested lead and maintains sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The pace-setter can dictate ideal splits while the mass of hold-up horses struggle to close sufficient ground in the straight. Prominent trackers get first run at the leader when the race develops.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely slow and bunches up the field
scenarios.body: The hold-up brigade gets their preferred scenario with plenty to aim at in a sprint finish. Class and finishing kick become decisive over tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Special
scenarios.trigger: If City Of Poets goes too slow early and gets swamped by multiple challengers
scenarios.body: The race becomes a cavalry charge with hold-up horses and prominent runners converging simultaneously. Raw ability trumps tactics in a messy finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If one of the supposed hold-up horses breaks character and presses City Of Poets early
scenarios.body: The front-runner faces unexpected pressure, potentially setting up a different tempo that could compromise both early protagonists. Mid-division horses benefit from the honest pace.

races.paceDynamic: Sergeant Wilko and Sunriseontheboyne will contest the early lead in this 14-runner handicap, with both showing consistent front-running tendencies. The dual pace angle should create an honest gallop through the first half-mile, though neither possesses blazing early speed. Prominent runners like Persuasion, Sujet, and Brighton Boy will track the leaders closely, while the large field contains numerous hold-up horses including Andesite, Perfect Part, and Mudamer. This pace setup strongly favours prominent racers who can position handy and kick when the early leaders weaken, rather than hold-up horses who may struggle to get competitive positions in the big field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the dual pace creates steady fractions without collapse
scenarios.body: The honest gallop will expose the front runners in the final furlong, allowing handy horses to strike with superior finishing kicks. Prominent runners with tactical speed will have optimal positioning to exploit the pace scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one pace-setter gets first run and the other folds early
scenarios.body: A single leader will get loose and control the tempo, making the race a staying test rather than a speed duel. The survivor will prove tough to peg back despite carrying the field along.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes pedestrian
scenarios.body: Slow early fractions will turn this into a sprint finish where the best finishers can overcome positioning disadvantages. The field will compress entering the straight, creating gaps for closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners show no early speed and crawl along
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace will create a tactical affair with multiple horses hitting the front. Late runners will get their chance in a messy finish where positioning matters less.

races.paceDynamic: Stormy Pearl and Eldeyaar are confirmed front-runners who will contest the early lead, creating an honest gallop over this sharp 6f trip. With 7 runners wanting prominent positions including Ganesha, Valsharah, Run This Way, Master Dandy and Sanbona, there will be significant congestion 2-3 furlongs out as they funnel into the straight. The dual pace angle creates a moderate tempo that sets up perfectly for hold-up horses to finish strongly, while the prominent pack faces traffic problems. This race shape clearly favours closers and patient tactics.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion causes interference and the pace stays honest
scenarios.body: The early leaders tire from their battle while traffic problems hinder the prominent brigade, leaving a clear path for the closers. Dream Deal, Andalprofit and Solar Biricz can exploit their patient styles perfectly.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Rider Gets Through
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses finds a clean passage through the traffic
scenarios.body: Despite the congestion, a well-positioned prominent runner avoids trouble and benefits from the solid pace. Run This Way's recent win and Master Dandy's consistency give them the best chance to navigate cleanly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives Duel
scenarios.trigger: If either Stormy Pearl or Eldeyaar gets first run on their rival
scenarios.body: The winner of the early battle finds enough reserves to hold off the closers on this sharp track. Eldeyaar's recent victory gives him a slight edge over Stormy Pearl in a sustained battle.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too fast and burn out before halfway
scenarios.body: The early gallop becomes unsustainable, leaving the field bunched and creating a sprint finish. This would suit the prominent horses who conserved energy behind the foolish pace.
